_comment: The registry of every declared difference between `jaune t8n` and the conformance target on the committed corpus. scripts/check-t8n.sh applies each entry to the GOLDEN side before comparing; nothing is applied to Jaune's output, whose bytes are compared as written. Each entry pins Jaune's exact expected bytes as well as the target's, so an unregistered difference and a changed registered one both fail the gate. scripts/report-t8n.md carries the full justification.
_messages_comment: `rejected[].error` and `blockException` carry free text with no normative content. Every transition tool writes its own, and the framework maps the text to a canonical identity through the registered wrapper's exception mapper rather than comparing it (execution_testing/exceptions/exception_mapper.py). Jaune therefore writes its own canonical vocabulary -- the official identity Jaune/FixtureException.lean already assigns to each typed reason -- rather than imitating another tool's wording. Every pair below maps to the same official identity on both sides. A row's value is either the canonical identity on its own or an object carrying that identity under `jaune` beside the `owner` and `recorded` metadata of the goal that ruled on the row; scripts read only `jaune`.
_fields_comment: Per-case field exemptions. Each names the document, the JSON path, the target's exact value, and either Jaune's exact value or `jauneAbsent: true`. An entry whose target-side mechanism has been reported upstream also carries an `upstream` line naming the filing; scripts ignore the key.
